subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Should this issue be resolved by the broad non-wedging approval-flow fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498, the narrower watchdog alignment in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325, or a split sequence?
rationale: Two open closing PRs now target the same observable bug with different approval-boundary tradeoffs, and the newer broad fix has security-review questions that automation should not settle on this issue.

options.title: Repair And Land Broad Approval Fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix after its approval-boundary findings and real-behavior proof are addressed.

options.title: Land Narrow Watchdog Fix First
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 for the immediate 90s watchdog mismatch and keep popup metadata and non-wedging timeout semantics in separate follow-up work.

options.title: Split The Direction Explicitly
options.body: Close or retarget one PR after maintainers decide which approval semantics belong in the bug fix versus adjacent UX/security issues.

recommendation.title: Repair And Land Broad Approval Fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix after its approval-boundary findings and real-behavior proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee, owns the broader open fix branch, and has recent history on the affected Codex and approval surfaces.
